channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A Vermont Chamber of Commerce survey found that half of Vermont businesses raised prices in two thousand twenty-six. Healthcare is the biggest concern for business owners. Most companies are trying out artificial intelligence tools.

Independent grocery stores in Vermont are facing empty shelves due to a warehouse strike in New Hampshire. Deliveries have been disrupted, causing product shortages. Store owners are managing inventory amid the labor dispute.

A court ruled that Adirondack lake capacity studies are optional, not required by law. The DEC has discretion on when to conduct these studies. Environmental groups are disappointed and may appeal the decision.

Vermont Transportation Secretary Joe Flynn will retire November twentieth after leading major infrastructure projects since twenty sixteen. Public Service Commissioner Kerrick Johnson is also retiring after guiding energy policy since twenty twenty-four. Governor Phil Scott thanked both for their service.
